get.description: Requires catalog.write. The twenty-five newest jobs, newest first — enough for the drawer to show what happened last, not a history. A job records its outcome (done, failed, or blocked by Amazon's robot check) and every warning the import raised along the way.

post.summary: Import a product from an Amazon listing
post.description: Requires catalog.write. Starts a job and answers 202 at once; poll the job for progress. The job opens the URL in a real Chrome, reads the listing and each variation's own page, rewrites the copy with Claude when a key is configured, adjusts the pictures, and creates the product — as a draft unless told otherwise. Prices cross only when the marketplace sells in the store's currency; otherwise price_minor sets every variant, or none is set and the job says so.

url.description: An Amazon product page — any marketplace, /dp/ or /gp/product/.

max_variants.description: How many variation pages to visit — one of each colour first, then the sizes. A variant past the cap is created with the parent's price and the pictures of a visited variant of its colour, or the parent's when none was.

price_minor.description: A price for every variant, in the store's currency — the way to import from a marketplace that sells in another.

get.description: Requires catalog.write. While running, step and message say where it is; once finished, status is done, failed or blocked, product_id names what was created, and warnings lists everything worth reading before publishing.

ImportAmazonImageOptions.description: What to do to every picture: the background, the lighting and the orientation, never the content. By default a plain background is replaced with a soft gradient and a shadow, the lighting is lifted a touch, and the subject is turned three degrees and drawn a little smaller so the turn fits. Warmth and saturation are available and off, because they change the product rather than the photograph. A photo without a plain background (a lifestyle shot) gets the lighting change only. Mirroring is on by default; it reverses any text in a picture.

brightness.description: Added to every channel as a fraction of full scale.

contrast.description: Scales distance from mid-grey; 0 or 1 leaves it alone.

warmth.description: Colour balance: positive towards amber, negative towards blue. Off by default: it changes the product's colour.

saturation.description: Colour away from grey; 0 or 1 leaves it alone. Off by default, for the same reason.

background.description: What replaces a plain background: nothing, one colour, or a vertical gradient from background_color to background_to.

scale.description: Shrinks the subject about the centre so the new background shows around it; 1 leaves it alone.

tilt.description: Turns the subject by a few degrees, clockwise positive — the orientation change that does not reverse text.

shadow.description: A soft shadow under the subject on the new background.

flip.description: Horizontal by default. A horizontal flip reverses any text in the picture.

step.description: While running: fetching, fetched, optimizing, images, creating.
